properties.markdown: **How to read this dashboard.** The first section is aligned into three vertical stories: migration results, worker capacity, and target feedback. Read across a row to explain a rate change, then down a column for detail. The second section shows throughput and request shape; later sections are diagnosis and controller internals. Rates are fleet totals unless marked otherwise. CloudWatch fleet gauges are one-minute averages, so worker counts can be fractional during transitions. The controls are specified in RFS/docs/BULK_TRAFFIC_CONTROL.md.

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="throttled_429"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="admission_rejected"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: Target throttled

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="timeout"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="connection_reset"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="connect_failed"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: No response

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="payload_413"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="other_4xx"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="5xx"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER" outcome="other_status"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: Other errors

properties.title: Documents sent vs migrated per second
Requests in flight vs adaptive allowance

metrics.expression: 100 * (m1 / PERIOD(m1)) / (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,container,namespace,pod} MetricName="container_spec_cpu_quota" container="bulk-loader" namespace="ma"', 'Average', 60)) / AVG(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,container,namespace,pod} MetricName="container_spec_cpu_period" container="bulk-loader" namespace="ma"', 'Average', 60)))
metrics.label: % (fleet capacity)

properties.title: Target indexing rate and write queue

Target searchable documents (thousands) and used space (GB)

metrics.expression: SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttemptDuration" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'Sum', 60)) / SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttemptDuration" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'SampleCount', 60)) / 1000
metrics.label: Mean

metrics.expression: SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,errorClass,qualifier} MetricName="bulkRetryDelay" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'Sum', 60)) / SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,errorClass,qualifier} MetricName="bulkRetryDelay" OTelLib="documentMigration" qualifier="MA_QUALIFIER"', 'SampleCount', 60)) / 1000
